method: One OpenOCD session: init; resume; three packet memory samples spaced 5 seconds apart; shutdown. No image loaded during observation. Debugger reset/resume is not an untouched power-cycle test.
board_init: 150MHz FC/100MHz CL; no voltage change; simplified direct frequency calls without earlier optional voltage code or 100ms waits.
failure_cause: Earlier stall and CRC symptoms cleared after JTAG reattachment. No proven stack overlap or callback software defect; do not claim a definitive root cause.
